methodology: Dedicated headless browsers, sequential samples, regular preview headers. First load ends at visible Home action. Inspect starts after picker selection. First frame is not proof of program readiness. Confirmed output includes physical-key simulation at 35 ms/key plus actual guest file export. No timing is a human usability result. RSS is a sampled process-tree sum, not unique heap or peak WASM memory.

configuration.mount: whole package at C:/, writable temporary

runs.coldNetwork: CDP 20 Mbit/s aggregate, minimum 50 ms request-to-headers latency; no CPU throttling
